name: Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria
detailed_description:
BUILD. BREW. DEFEND.

Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria combines classic tower defense strategy with a unique alchemy system and a deep fantasy storyline. Choose your hero, construct powerful defenses, combine towers with magical potions – and fight for the fate of your kingdom.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Eight towers – endless possibilities: Each tower comes with unique abilities and can be upgraded through dozens of talents.

  • Alchemy meets strategy: Brew potions to enhance your defense or exploit enemy weaknesses.

  • Epic campaign: Uncover the truth behind your bloodline and the dark legacy of Vampire King Zadicus.

  • Endless mode: Face procedurally generated challenges and enhance your talents with each run.

  • Streamer mode: Play with or against your favorite streamer – or let your chat influence the battlefield.

In Tower Alchemist, you can choose from eight different towers, including the classic arrow tower, the destructive cannon tower, and magical towers like fire, water, and life.

Each tower has unique abilities and can be customized through dozens of talents – from faster attacks to chain reactions or area-of-effect damage. Combining these upgrades creates powerful synergies that can determine the outcome of each battle.

Enemies come with different armor types, such as:

  • 🔥 Chaos is weak against Order

  • 💀 Death is effectively countered by Life

  • 🔥 Fire can be neutralized by Water

  • and more.

Clever tower choice and placement are key to a successful defense.

You're joined by a selectable companion, each with unique special potions. These can be used during battle to help you overcome even the most powerful bosses.

Some potion effects include:

  • Slow: Reduces the speed of enemy groups

  • Poison: Deals damage over time

  • Reveal: Uncovers invisible enemies

  • Root: Temporarily immobilizes enemies

  • Chaos Elixir: Randomly swaps enemy armor types – with unpredictable results

Each potion can be discovered in the world of Khaldoria or researched during the campaign. Your companion will become an essential part of your strategy.

Choose between Milan or Sofjia, and follow them on their journey through a kingdom in chaos. Uncover ancient family secrets, fight through enemy-infested regions, and reveal the truth about your royal bloodline.

At the center stands the aging Vampire King Zadicus, whose reign is slowly crumbling. Your decisions will determine whether Khaldoria falls – or a new era rises.

Ready for the ultimate challenge?
In Endless Mode, you'll face a constantly increasing difficulty level and persistent talent trees to perfect your playstyle.

Every run is different. Every mistake matters. But every defeat brings you one step closer to the perfect build.

Whether solo or with friends, this mode will test your strategic skills to the limit.
Note: The multiplayer mode is planned to launch after the main release.

short_description: Build mighty towers and use the power of alchemy to give your towers new abilities or crush your enemies. Prepare for dozens of abilities from your opponents. Gain victory through your sophisticated strategy and defend your homeland, the Kingdom of Khaldoria in the thrilling story mode.
